source: GitHub recursive Git tree for the source commit; Git object IDs of assets and adjacent .meta files
scope: Tracked .prefab and .mat files across repository; no changes to assets
caveats: A Git blob SHA identifies the Git-stored content and is not a Unity GUID or a proof of runtime render state.
Git LFS files are represented by pointer blobs in Git; content integrity requires LFS materialization separately. Six FCGTrafficCars prefabs are LFS pointer entries.
The 104 MB CityVisual.prefab is included by Git blob ID without downloading or rewriting it.
Runtime-instantiated/dynamically loaded resources, shader support, missing material slots, scene dependencies and Unity import outcomes must be checked in Unity.
This is a comparison/baseline inventory, never an unused-assets or safe-to-delete list.
